source.title: Pentagon says thousands of US troops are poised to strike Iran. Then reports emerge of what happened to five tankers in the Strait of Hormuz

event.text: Iranian forces say five oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after mine strikes.

source.title: IRGC Says 2 Tankers Hit Mines as US Disables M/V Huda

event.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two oil tankers hit mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, hours after US forces disabled a cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.
